correctness.rationale: PASS: Uniform barycentric Gram matrix has diagonal two and off-diagonal one divided by (d+1)(d+2), yielding vertex affine kernel K_d=(d+1)(d+2)U-(d+1). Globally affine product space decomposes orthogonally as constants and centered factorwise affine spaces, so K=AU+BV-(d+e+3), mean one. Convexity of integrated |K| in evaluation point forces a vertex maximum; sign(K) attains it and indicator of K<0 attains negative defect B=E[(C-AU-BV)_+]. Independent beta densities give exact inclusion-exclusion rational double hinge sum. dU and eV converge independently to Exp(1), bounded normalized hinge leads to 2b(theta). Pointwise hinge convexity plus positive probability of a kink-crossing yields strict convexity, symmetric minimum 1/2 with b=2e^-2 and endpoints e^-1. Independent exact rational symmetry/hinge checks on 36 (d,e) pairs, plus square integral and examples 233/108, 11/4, 1027567/311040 support finite values, not entire proof.
